<?php
class NullableIntGet {
    public function __get(string $name): ?int { echo $name, ":"; if ($name === "nil") { return null; } return true; }
}
class NullableFloatGet {
    public function __get(?string $name): ?float { echo $name, ":"; if ($name === "nil") { return null; } return 2; }
}
class NullableBoolGet {
    public function __get(int|string $name): ?bool { echo $name, ":"; if ($name === "nil") { return null; } return 0; }
}
class NullableStringGet {
    public function __get(mixed $name): ?string { echo $name, ":"; if ($name === "nil") { return null; } return "kept"; }
}
$reader = new NullableIntGet;
$selector = "nil";
echo $reader->$selector === null ? "IN;" : "BAD;";
echo $reader->value === 1 ? "IV;" : "BAD;";
$reader = new NullableFloatGet;
echo $reader->nil === null ? "FN;" : "BAD;";
$selector = "value";
echo $reader->$selector;
echo ";";
$reader = new NullableBoolGet;
echo $reader->nil === null ? "BN;" : "BAD;";
echo $reader->$selector === false ? "BV;" : "BAD;";
$reader = new NullableStringGet;
echo $reader->nil === null ? "SN;" : "BAD;";
echo $reader->value;
echo ";";
$reader->nil;
echo "DROP;DONE;";
